question: Which surah contains a specific warning against an individual enemy of the Prophet (pbuh) and his wife?
What does the phrase حَمَّالَةَ ٱلْحَطَبِ mean in Surah Al-Lahab?

options.A: the destruction of those who reject faith
options.C: Abu Lahab and his wife who opposed the Prophet

english_translation: in her neck is a twisted rope of palm fibre
question: According to Surah Al-Lahab, what will be around the neck of Abu Lahab's wife in the Hereafter?

options.D: a twisted rope of palm fibre

arabic_text: مَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُ مَالُهُۥ وَمَا كَسَبَ
english_translation: His wealth and his children will not benefit him
question: What key lesson does Surah Al-Lahab teach about worldly possessions?

options.A: Wealth and possessions cannot save a person from Allah's punishment
options.B: Wealth should be distributed among the poor
options.C: Material success is a sign of Allah's favor
options.D: Children are more valuable than wealth
